Based on my search, here are some of the top stocks that analysts and financial experts are recommending to buy now in 2026:

## Top Stock Picks for June 2026

### Growth & Technology Stocks

**1. NVIDIA (NVDA)** - Leading AI chip production with a 65% revenue boost, essential for tech advancements

**2. CrowdStrike (CRWD)** - Best-in-breed cybersecurity company with $5B+ in annual recurring revenue and 80% subscription gross margin. The company sees its addressable market growing from $149B to $325B by 2030

**3. Apple (AAPL)** - Largest consumer electronics company with strong iPhone demand ($85B+ in holiday quarter sales) and fast-growing, high-margin Services unit

**4. Amazon (AMZN)** - Dominant in U.S. e-commerce and AWS cloud platform. Cloud industry expected to quadruple to $2.3 trillion by 2032

**5. Alphabet/Google (GOOGL)** - Leading internet search with growing Google Cloud (No. 3 market share) and Waymo self-driving technology. Recently initiated its first-ever dividend

**6. Shopify (SHOP)** - No. 2 in e-commerce by total payment volume with $153B market opportunity

**7. Airbnb (ABNB)** - 156M+ nights booked in Q1 2026, $4.5B free cash flow, 36% FCF margin

### International Growth

**8. MercadoLibre (MELI)** - Often called the "Amazon of Latin America" with e-commerce marketplace and fast-growing Mercado Pago payments platform ($350B annualized payment volume)

**9. Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM)** - Top undervalued international stock pick from Morningstar

### Healthcare & Innovation

**10. Intuitive Surgical (ISRG)** - Dominant robot-assisted surgery company with ~80% global market share and 23% revenue growth in Q1 2026

### Value & Dividend Stocks

**11. Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B)** - First non-technology company to reach $1 trillion market cap, with ~$400B in cash and strong portfolio of subsidiaries

**12. Walt Disney (DIS)** - 130M+ Disney+ subscribers, profitable streaming business, and $60B investment in theme parks and cruise line over 10 years

**13. Mercury General (MCY)** - Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with 44% projected EPS growth; benefits from California insurance rate changes

**14. Omnicom Group (OMC)** - Zacks dividend stock pick with 26.8% projected EPS growth

### Top Performers (May 2026)

According to Morningstar, the best-performing stocks in May 2026 were:
- **Dell Technologies (DELL)** - up 101% in May, 284% over past year
- **Micron Technology (MU)** - up 88% in May, 930% over past year
- **Snowflake (SNOW)** - up 87% in May
- **Datadog (DDOG)** - up 87% in May, 110% over past year

---

**Important Considerations:**
- Many of these stocks trade at elevated valuations, which could limit upside if growth doesn't meet expectations
- The market has been volatile in 2026 due to geopolitical conflicts, tariff uncertainty, and economic concerns
- Consider your risk tolerance, financial goals, and portfolio diversification before investing
- ETFs like Vanguard S&P 500 can provide stability alongside individual stock picks

---
